meanings.note: a large formal meal for many people

examples.text: У нас сегодня очень важный банкет.
examples.trans: We have a very important banquet today.
A lavish banquet was hosted in the restaurant.

examples.text: Проверьте все бары и старых друзей.
examples.trans: Check all the bars and old friends.
It is already morning. Our bar is closing.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
I can see the toy car.

examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.
All right, here you go. There, look.

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

examples.text: Настроение у меня действительно очень хорошее.
examples.trans: My mood really is very good.
This is indeed an important question.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Это журнал посетителей мэрии из полицейских вещдоков.
examples.trans: This is the mayor's visitor log from police evidence.
Don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Сейчас будешь чинить трубу. И унитаз не забудь помыть.
examples.trans: Now you're going to fix the pipe. And don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Я вечером загляну ещё, сейчас чайку вам принесу.
examples.trans: I'll drop in again this evening; right now I'll bring you some tea.

examples.text: Я случайно заглянула в журнал заказов.
examples.trans: I happened to glance into the order book.

examples.text: Я делаю всё точно по вашему заказу.
examples.trans: I do everything exactly according to your order.
In the kitchen they are preparing this order.

замотаться.gloss: to be run off one's feet

meanings.en: to be run off one's feet, to get swamped (with things to do)
meanings.note: Colloquial: прости, замотался = sorry, I've been swamped.

examples.trans: Lena, sorry, I've been run off my feet today.
Oh, I've just been so swamped.

meanings.note: Of a person: я занят = I'm busy.
of a place: здесь занято = it's occupied

записать.gloss: to write down; to save (a contact)

meanings.en: to write down, to note; to record
to save (a contact in a phone)

examples.text: Я знаю, как я у тебя записан.
examples.trans: I know what I'm saved as in your phone.

examples.text: Я знаю, как я у тебя в телефоне записан. Свин.
examples.trans: I know what I'm saved as in your phone. 'Pig'.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.trans: I have no money at all.

examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Разве ты не знал об этом?
